surfaces.label: Shape model
surfaces.coverage: Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. Both views use the gray grid for source-flagged poorly constrained regions. Source constraints keeps solid gray for stereo control and blue for limb silhouettes. Grid regions lack those constraints; they are not necessarily wholly unobserved. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The combined model pole is retained at RA 255°, Dec +64.5°. Rotational phase is arbitrary and held fixed; no encounter or current rotation reconstruction is claimed.

surfaces.label: Deep Impact · 2005
surfaces.coverage: Photographs taken as the impactor approached Tempel 1, before the collision. Wider views surround a closer view of the impact region. The gray grid marks gaps; the original shadows remain.

areaCoverage.method: Deterministic equal-area barycentric samples on every retained triangle; excludes atlas bleed
